label: Spain SAM
author: tomasvicente38.
description:
The beginning of Railroad in Spain dates from 1848. First line from Barcelona to Mataro, some 29 km, was open on the October 28. 1848. In 1849 queen Isabela II opened the Madrid-Aranjuez line, which represented first 45 km of the Madrid-Alicante line. The railroad continued expanding in Spain and all major lines of the network were created in less than two decades. The length of the network went from 305 km in 1855 to almost 5,000 km in 1868.

When civil war ended in 1939, many railway lines and stations were damaged or destroyed. To restore the railroad, Spain nationalized it in 1941 and created Spanish National Railway Network (R.E.N.F.E). It now owns all railroads in the country with the exception of few local commuter lines.

Pride of current R.E.N.F.E is modern high speed transportation. Spain adopted TGV technology developed in cooperation between France, Germany and Japan. Spanish 'TGV' is called AVE (acronym equivalent to BIRD in English). First line of AVE was open in 1992 between Madrid and Seville, train crosses distance of 471 km in 2.5 hours. Newest line between Madrid and Barcelona is expected to open in 2007 with speeds up to 300 km/h. This line will also extend the network to the French border.

label: Northern Germany Sam
author: Lama_LT
description:
Develop the rural economy of Northern Germany at the turn of the twentieth century.

  In this scenario, there are three types of passengers - 3rd, 2nd, and 1st class.  Villages, towns, and cities produce third-class passengers.  Towns and cities produce 2nd-class passengers if supplied with 3rd-class passengers.  Cities produce 1st-class passengers if supplied with 2nd-class passengers.

  The industries that produce raw materials (grain, milk, swine, fish, and wood) also require a supply of third-class passengers in order to produce any output.

  While third-class passengers pay very little, they are the essential basis for the entire economy of the map, and thus a valuable resource.  Take advantage of the available chains of production to increase supply, to make available higher-value-added cargo, and to achieve the scenario goals.

  You can also increase supply by building service buildings in the communities.  Hotels, ticket offices, restaurants, post offices, and railway express agencies will increase the value and supply of passengers, mail, or express cargo.

  Finally, this scenario runs on 'slow time', with one month of game time taking three times as long in real time as in normal scenarios.

description:
A latecomer in railway construction, the Grand Duchy of Oldenburg built a network that made the most of a thinly settled, economically weak country.
	When economic development finally picked up toward the end of the nineteenth century, however, the railroad was there to allow farmers access to markets.

*Special Rules*
	On this map, everything is much slower than you may expect.  Industries produce at a leisurely pace, and depots take longer to put together a consist and load a train.  Upgrading stations is more expensive than usual.
	For that reason, it may make sense to leave a train's consist intact over several local stops, even if the cars will remain empty part of the way.  You save valuable time by changing consists only at stations or terminals, if at all.

label: Aberdeen, Carolina & Western RR SAM2
author: STEP Inc
description:
The Aberdeen, Carolina and Western Railway was incorporated in 1987 and operates on a former Norfolk Southern Railway branch line, running from Aberdeen to Star, North Carolina. It also leases track from Norfolk Southern between Charlotte and Gulf, North Carolina. It serves approximately 18 industries, mainly dealing in forest and agricultural products.  

In laying track attempt to keep it to single line and with passing tracks only at cities as needed. Run branch lines directly from the mainline to the Annex.  This is the real challenge of the map, to run it as it is run in reality.  Also, have only one of each engine on the map at a time.	

This map begins in 1994 and runs thru 2025, with three eras.  For most of the first era you will only have two engines to work with, so watch your routing.

Back story

Back in September of 2008 I was looking thru some photos of shortlines and found the Aberdeen, Carolina and Western. After much help from the members of STEP Inc and a lot of sleepless nights we came up with this 18x18 map of south-central North Carolina. This railroad was created to take over a job that a couple of larger railroads didn't want to do anymore, and has prospered since.

For more information on the ACWR go here: http://www.acwr.com/ 

If you go into 'CUSTOMERS' and scroll down you will find access to a map of the present line. The map you are playing is laid out as close to this as I could get, with the businesses placed where they appear also. The idea of this map is to lay single rail, with the shortest possible branch lines to access Annexes. Passing track should only be laid at depots as needed. Bridges are expensive and there are only two types, Stone for short bridges and Deck Girder, which is very costly, for the one needed crossing of the river. The Stone are expensive, so conform to the landscape as much as possible. Tunnels are allowed, IF you want to lay out $30 Million a section!

Now you can probably run this map, and most likely win, if you just make runs where you chose, but that is not the real challenge of it. One track from Charlotte to Gulf, and one from somewhere between Star and Troy down to Aberdeen, and take it from there. The other thing is to have only one of each Engine on the map at a time. Here is the list of Engines and the year they appear:

1992 -- ACWR 3802 GP38-2
1994 -- ACWR 3803 GP38-2
2002 -- ACWR 703 GP40-2WL
2003 -- ACWR 2077 GP38-2
2004 -- ACWR 9556 GP40-2WL
2007 -- ACWR 4500 F7A
2007 -- ACWR 4501 F7A
2008 -- ACWR 9529 GP40-2WL

The map also contains a few new cars, a tank container, a flat car hauling steel plates, a rib-sided covered hopper and a high-sided open hopper. I'd also like to thank MrScott1964 for his four coal cars, the C&O, the DLW, the Erie and the LV. They saved me a few days work. Thanks also goes to Choobacca for his BN and BNSF covered hoppers, which I upped the detail on for this map.

One last thing, one of our testers mentioned that the pointer was difficult for him to use. If this is the case for you, just go in and delete the Pointer.ani file and you'll go back to the original pointer.

Place the Maps folder into your UserMaps. You can now play the map. You might want to do a zip of the folder first for storage for later playing.

Good luck and watch for head-butting engines.

As always if you find any errors, drop us a line and we'll pull the maintenance crew out of their card game and get them right on it.

NOTE:  A missing file was found ( thank-you K-class ) and the employee was docked 40 hours pay.  We also looked into the bridge thing and think it may have been settings we did to keep long bridges from being built.  We decided to take another path to that, simply raising the cost of the bridges.  They are still cheaply made, the bridge company owner is just getting a bigger mansion and yacht.

label: Rags to Riches SAM
author: Jancsika
description:
A 10 X 10 map. 64 turns per month.
Single player, with emphasis on industry.
This is primitive and wasteful society to start with. They are cutting the precocious forest and burning them locally in their villages to produce energy. They also have a scheme to produce paper, but it does not go anywhere. The paper just will not materialize. Every village will start with its small power plant and a papper mill. These are filler industries to occupy building slots. In order to build new industry you have to grow them to City. There are only enough empty building slots to satisfy the Scenario requirements.

 The food chain has six steps from Oil to Food. Fertilizer will increase production of Grain and Grapes by 150%. Without fertilizer the farms and vinyards are only 50% productive.
 After the population has satisfactory food supply, the tourist industry will pick up. Gambling and good hospitality will bring gold.
 Next you will have to build heavy industry. This is an eight step process from Taconite Mine, Iron, Steel, Automobiles, Scrap Metal, Machinery to export.
Last develop fine craftsmanship and export your Chippendale for shiny gold.
The landscape is extremely mountainous; you will have to find gradual routing, because the tunnels and bridges are expensive and also ugly.

description: LOOK AHEAD-LOOK SOUTH.  This map covers the region of the US formerly served by the Southern Railroad (Washington to Jacksonville to New Orleans to St. Louis).  Formed over 160 years from the consolidation of over 150 rail lines, begining in 1830 with The BEST FRIEND OF CHARLESTON - America's 2nd RR owned by the South Carolina Canal and RR Co. A military target of the Union during the 1st Railroad War (Civil War) it was reorganized by J P Morgan in 1893 into the Southern RR.  Known as a first class modern RR with mottos: LOOK AHEAD - LOOK SOUTH, SOUTHERN SERVES THE SOUTH, and SOUTHERN GIVES A GREEN LIGHT TO INNOVATION. See if you can do as well as J P Morgan did. label: IBERIA SAM
author: Tomas Vicente
description: The first railway line in Spain dates from 1848, Barcelona-Mataro, about 29 km, opened on October the 28th of that year. In 1849 Queen Isabel II inaugurated the Madrid-Aranjuez line, the section that began the first 45 km of what became the Madrid-Alicante line.  The railroad continued to spread out in Spain so that in less than two decades they were granted the majority of the fundamental lines of the Spanish system.  Between 1855 and 1868, the railroad system passed 305 km to a total of nearly 5,000 km.  The civil war came to an end in 1939 and many railroads and stations were destroyed.  The State nationalized the system by the passing of a law in 1941. This law it created, the National Network of Spanish Railroads (Red Nacional de los Ferrocarriles Espaoles; RENFE) which included all the railroads of the State, except those of the narrows lines.  Spain adopted the high speed railroad (BIRD) from the French high tech TGV (chosen over the German, Italian and Japanese), to widen its' international Madrid-Seville line in 1992, which achieved a speed of 300 km/h. Soon there was a second line between Madrid and Barcelona that reached the French border.

label: Rodeas_Sodor_Island_v2_011.7z
description:
This is the SAM version of Sodor.
The credit for the design  should go to Rodea. All the new engines, many new industries, and of course the original game plot.
 If you have not played before, this is your chance! The industries are randomly placed, so every game is different.
I made some minor changes:
To keep with the story book aspect of the game, only the Thomas type engines were kept. The engines were reworked to reflect the gradual increase in performance. Thomas was also given some more prominent role.
I also changed the time. Instead of the original 150 years it is 38 years. This again to be more in line with the story. The turns per month is upped to 144 turns per month, but the engine maintenance cost was lowered to reflect the change.
You will be able to build only masonry bridges. Again this is to keep the story book appearance
Please note that the AI players have to be set to 0 (zero) otherwise the game will crash


As for the AI players: it is a marginal error. The game was designed for one player. The scenario is a performance based entity. You have certain quotas and time limits to meet, not to whack the AI.
Of course it would be nicer if did not occur.


2011 Update by Karsten

Changes from the 4.7.2009 SAM version:

- Goods file crashes fixed.
- Random event file crashes fixed.
- FPK files unpacked. 

Select no (ie zero) AI players to avoid a crash at start. 

Have fun with Rodea's challenging and delightful scenario!

Experience two of the most powerful railroads in American history, The New York Central and The Erie Railroads. Your beginings are humble, building railroads between major ports on the Erie Canal from Albany to Buffalo. 
Then to New York City.
Once New York City is reached, you will then travel the scenic route of The Erie Railroad through the Southern Tier of New York to Dunkirk. Then it's full steam ahead to the experience of a lifetime, enjoying 100 years of railroading through the Empire State and Pennsylvania.

label: Seefra3 SAM
author: Star Ranger4 / Railage
description:
Seefra 3 is cut off from the known worlds. An aspiring tycoon, you find yourself stranded here by some mistake. Technology is frowned upon, but perhaps a functioning rail network will change public opinion.	
	You find unique constraints. Passengers are produced only by Villages. All city sizes exchange Goods for Passengers. Larger cities have lower rates of exchange. Capzitolia has a Passenger for Passenger exchange at 5:2.
	Resource production low. All resource buildings are Large at game start. Will degrade in 2025 if unused. In-city industries convert at 2:1.
	Designed for play against 3 AI players. AI players use a special difficulty level.
	Track-laying is cheaper than normal. Use of sensible bridges and tunnels recommended.
	TGV included as a prototype, expensive to purchase and run.

label: Volcano Island SAM
author: NSrailfan
description: This is my biggest map yet being a 13 x 13. In this map there is a giant volcano in the center. All industries are on the island, but all resources are across the water. But beware bridges and tunnels cost a lot. So you might want to deliver mail and passengers for while to get started.

label: The Keystone State SAM
author: MrScott, NSrailfan
description: This is a map of Pennsylvania (A.K.A - The Keystone State). I would like to thank MrScott for the original map, and STEP Inc. for the custom goods,cars and industries.

label: Sodor V3.0 Random SAM
author: Rodea, Jancsika
description:
THERE ARE TROUBLES IN SODOR!!
	There was a greedy railroad tycoon who tried to build some rail lines, but went bankrupt and abandoned the rails and left Thomas and his friends to rust.
	You are given an oil can and moral authority to rebuild this abandoned island.
	First you have to restore and put Thomas and his friends in working order. 
	Second you have to build up the food supply, so that the people are well fed.
	You also have to bring the rails to every community to the island, so that you can can move the goods and workforce around.
	Once the villages are connected you assignment will be to bring prosperity to the land. You have to build up the industry and feed and clothe the people and make money for your backers.(This is Capitalism after all!)

label: West Sumatera SAM V3.0
author: Rodea2007
description: West Sumatera SAM. This design is all by Rodea. Jancsika modified the the XML files for a SAM version.

label: Mill Valley SAM
author: zzbuch
description: My new Mill Valley edit.

label: The Gold King SAM
author: Slider38
description:
In the mid 1870s, Jacob Waltz walked out of the Superstition Mountains carrying a sack of gold.  This was repeated many times over the next 10 years.  When Waltz died in 1891 the legend of the Dutchman's Lost Gold Mine began.  In 1892 the Black Queen gold mine was established in the Superstitions and the gold rush was on.  Prospectors flocked to the area staking claims in the mountains.  The railroads vied to supply the gold camps with needed goods and to haul the gold ore coming out of the mountains.  Outwit your opponents and prosper hauling the needed goods.  Take control of the map and you will be the Gold King.

The Gold King - Goods/Industries List			

Industry	Produces	Deliver to	
	Good		

Sawmill	Timbers	Gold Mine	

     'Gold Mine	Gold Ore	Gold Smelter	

     'Gold Smelter 	Gold	Bank	

Sawmill	Timbers	Silver Mine	
			
     'Silver Mine	Silver Ore	Silver Smelter	
			
     'Silver Smelter	Silver	Bank	

Cattleranch	Livestock	Slaughterhouse

     'Slaughterhouse	Food	Town, city, metro

     'Indian Camps	Indian Blankets	General Store

     'Forts	Soldiers	Towns & Cities

label: Great Britain SAM2
author: McBarnacle
description: UK Railway Scenario

label: Canadian Pacific SAM
author: TMiller/Grizzly
description: The Canadian Pacific (CP) was the first transcontinental railroad in Canada, running from Thunder Bay in Ontario, across the plains of Manitoba, Saskatchewan, and Alberta, then across the Rocky Mountains of British Columbia to Vancouver on the west coast of Canada.  The first train to travel the entire route arrived in Vancouver on June 30, 1886.  Granted 25 million acres of land by the Canadian government, the railroad encouraged European immigrants by offering low cost travel packages to move to western Canada.  Immigrants travelled on a CP ship, then on CP train and bought farmland on the plains from CP for as little as $2.50 per acre.  Families could travel by train in a compartment car with beds and small kitchen.  See if you can build a successful railroad in western Canada and meet all the victory objectives.  The map is fairly large (21x21) and is intended to be played with 3 AIs.  Good Luck.

label: My Old Kentucky Home Redeaux
author: slider38
description: Welcome to My Old Kentucky Home Redeaux.  This is a SAM that plays in 4 Eras.  The map was designed as a Multiplayer map. The map includes some different music, all performed by artists from Kentucky.  You will find some new goods, industries, etc.  It even has a few dogwood trees.  My testing was done at the Mogul level against 3 AI players.  I hope you find the map fun to play.

label: MID EAST SAM2
author: d53642
description: MID_EAST

label: Western Russia Sam
author: Recoup
description: Russia's railways began rapid expansion after the creation of the Trans-Siberian rail network. Guide Russia through her development in both the late 19th century into end of the Soviet Union.

label: Basin And Range SAM
author: Big Papa and Choobacca
description: Ever wonder what it would be like to run a real railroad? This scenario will give you command of two Railways: the Atchison, Topeka and Santa Fe Railway from 1950, and the Burlington Northern Railway starting in 1970. Then experience their merger to form the Burlington Northern and Santa Fe Railway in 1997. Take a ride on a Super Chief passenger train, or transport double stack containers with dual AC-4400s. Build the railroad of your dreams with over 25 real-life engine paint schemes from these railways.

label: Peace In The Golden Crescent V1 SAM2
author: Jancsika
description:
After years of difficult negotiations peace was restored.
During the long wars the area was totally devastated. Your assignment is to restore stability to the region. In order to do that you have to utilize the abundant natural resources and engage the population to participate in developing those resources.
The first step is to provide locally produced food to the people and start up the clothing industry.

label: UK Lower SAM
author: Jowe10
description:
Set in the lower part of the United Kingdom
	
You are going to need to move people around the region early to prepare for extensive growth later. Later, you will have to move food and milk to support the growing region and then help modernize it by introducing automobile travel.  Finally you will have to create an industrial empire and monoploize the region.

label: Florida Gold SAM2
author: Lowell
description:
The belief that Florida land was too sandy or marshy for profitable development had been a common concern in the Deep South for generations.
The Florida railroaders showed the entire world the bountiful crops that South Florida could produce.
Your Florida adventure begins after the second world war in 1946. The end of Steam and the beginning of Diesel.

label: Georgia on My Mind SAM
author: slider38
description: Welcome to Georgia On My Mind.  This map was designed as a single player SAM (Stand Alone Map).  There are no crossovers.  You must switch through to cross existing track.  The map runs in 3 Eras from 1940 to 2000.  Be aware that it takes 2 loads of wood to create 1 load of lumber.  Spread your track out when you can.  Spaghetti track is your enemy.  You may find it advantageous to build industries where you need them.  You may also find times when removing existing trains can be helpful.  I hope that you enjoy the map.

label: Rift Valley Revisited SAM2
author: Bushdoctor/Jancsika
description:
Build a Railroad Empire in Rift Valley.	
This scenario was designed to be played at Mogul/Hard/No AI.
	
- Careful: Money is tight and things are expensive.
- Manage your lines well and think ahead.
- Some of your trains will never be profitable. Deal with that.
- Regular passengers are slow workers.
- Specialists are fast workers but are harder to find.
- Hardbottle makes for a tricky start. Instructions at bottom.
- Original scenario by Jancsika - Revisited version by Bushdoctor.
- Have fun!

Completing the first era when starting at Hardbottle.
------------- Careful: Spoiler Alert.---------------

Follow the canyon, pass through Hobbiton and connect with Harland.
Build depots in Hobbiton and Harland. Now sell all of your track
north of your depot in Hobbiton, including your original Terminal.
This will generate the cash to upgrade both remaining depots to 
stations. Run a passenger train between the two and use its income 
to connect Harland to Farland. Finally, build a station in Farland.
First era complete.

Good luck!

label: Amerigonia Duals SAM
author: Dr Frag/vzbob
description: The newly formed country needs major help with its infrastructure. If it is going to compete with the rest of the world you will need to build a thriving economy to prove Amerigonia is a serious contender in International trade.

label: Europa2 Deluxe Standard Version SAM
author: Paf-Daddy
description: This scenario contains many cities of europe. *STANDARD VERSION* Map by PaF Daddy

label: Hill Valley Mess SAM
author: Snoopy55
description: This multiplayer map is designed for four players.  This map contains very little in the way of hills or valleys, so tracks will be cheap and trains will be fast.  The trains and economy are based on the Northeast US scenario.

label: Germany Deluxe
author: PaF Daddy
description: This scenario contains some of Germany's biggest cities and some cities of the neighbor countries. The industries are placed randomly at every start of the map. Have fun! Its a 225 x 225 map.

label: America SAM
author: Stormfather
description:
Change log
1_01 - Fixed a crash resulting from a nonexistent goods "corn"

This scenario, which runs from 1843 until 1993, is suitable for players of all skill levels. It covers the continental US, as well as portions of Mexico and Canada.  This version of the map uses random placement of industries and resources.

label: Wood Valley SAM
author: NSrailfan
description: A fictional society that processes all sorts of wood products.

label: The High Desert SAM
author: slider38
description: This map covers the high desert area of Southern California.  It is designed as a single-player map but it should play reasonably well with AI.  The map is a SAM (Stand Alone Map) and runs in 3 Eras from 1850 to 1940.  There are no crossovers on this map.  To cross existing track you must switch through.  There are a couple of new goods, industries, etc.  I hope that you enjoy The High Desert.

label: Southern Ontario SAM
author: d53642
description: This scenario covers the Southern Ontario, an area stretching from Windsor in the most Southwest to Kingston in the Northeast, Beth NY in the Southeast and North Bay in the Northwest.  It covers the time period 1800 - 1970, which spans the humble beginnings of the American steam trains through the modern era of diesels. It is recommended for advanced players level.

label: Iceland SAM2
author: Mike Kennelly
description: Craggy Volcanic island in the North Atlantic. Sparsely populated, volcanic, Iceland is obviously not known for its rail network. But we're about to change that.

label: Basin And Range Revision 2 SAM
author: Big Papa and Choobacca / Lowell
description:
Ever wonder what it would be like to run a real railroad? This scenario will give you command of two Railways: the Atchison, Topeka and Santa Fe Railway from 1950, and the Burlington Northern Railway starting in 1970. Then experience their merger to form the Burlington Northern and Santa Fe Railway in 1997. Take a ride on a Super Chief passenger train, or transport double stack containers with dual AC-4400s. Build the railroad of your dreams with over 25 real-life engine paint schemes from these railways.

In memory of Big Papa and Choobacca, I thought it would be nice to enlarge the landmap to a size 18. Money has been added and the time has been extended a tad to compensate. All objectives are the same as the size 13 map.

label: East Coast Fixed Industries SAM
author: Jancsika
description:
In this version the placement of industries is fixed. The scenario requirements are rather demanding. All industries are stock Firaxis industries.
The map represents the eastern half of the United States. The contours are somewhat exaggerated to make it more challenging. Tunnels and steel bridges are expensive so you have to route around the obstacles.

label: France Alternate Universe SAM
author: Jancsika
description:
There has been a tremendous upheaval and explosion. All the volcanoes in Iceland and the Italian peninsula simultaneously blew up, fracturing and scattering the earth crust. Fortunately Paris has remained in the same spot, but parts of France were thrown all over the drained Atlantic and Mediterranean basins.
Your assignment is connect these cities and restore the French empire to its previous glory.
Unfortunately the British Islands completely disappeared.

label: Great Britain AI version SAM2
author: McBarnacle
description:
UK Railway Scenario. 	
This edition is designed for play against 3 AI. At game start there are only a handful of industries. You must build the rest. Major goal is growing cities. Perhaps the AI can help you with this task.
Track and stations cost more. In-station express revenues are down. Station loading times have increased slightly. Terminal here acts like normal Station. Upgrade benefits don't update with the changes. Think roughly half the displayed figures.
This map uses patents that have only negative effects. The AI will buy them anyway. Once a patent expires, merging that AI company will apply those effects again. Its recommended to merge the AI last.

label: Arizona_Gold_v1.7z
description:
Arizona Gold Scenario:

1871 – The Civil War has taught the nation that if it wishes to hold the Pacific Coast firmly to the Union, efficient transport will have to be provided, to limit the chance that some foreign country might annex California. Due to concerns of the Indian Reserves, construction is slow up to 1881, but then the Atlantic Pacific Railroad is rushed to completion with princely subsidies of land and money.

1930 – To counter the Great Depression, the U.S. Government finances Hoover Dam Project. Las Vegas receives thousands of depression-weary job seekers, who help build the world’s largest gravity dam.

1970 – Tourism comes of age as major economic activity, in Las Vegas and in beautiful Arizona.

label: Hurricane_v2.7z
description:
A devastating hurricane destroyed the fishing and gambling industries at the Atlantic seaboard. You are given the assignment to restore the fishing, hotels and casinos. You have 6 years to complete.

This is small 10 X 10 map. It should appeal of folks who like to build railroads. Money will be plentiful but to get the different goals you will have to rearrange the rails mid game unless you have a powerful enough computer. I try to keep the rail mileage under 4000 miles and the trains under 10. I wish there was a scenario condition to limit the trains and rail length.

label: Austrian Hungarian Monarchy SAM
author: Jancsika
description:
The rise and fall of the Austrian Hungarian Monarchy  1867 _1919 
If you are interested in history here is a Wiki link http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Austria-Hungary
The map is a 15X15 SAM. 96 turns_month.
The names of the cities are from a contemporary Rand McNally map, many of them changed several times during the span of the past 100 years.
There are three Eras, with three different scenario goals. It will be necessary to rearrange the rail lines.
The third Era is: World War I. It is a rather short timespan, five years _I changed it from 4_ so you have to be prepared for the switch. Be sure to have empty building slots to _build a War industry_.
There are 32 goods, that is the maximum allowed and it will slow down towards the game at the end.
You will not have to worry about enough money. The mail traffic will take care of it. Once the production of the other goods is sufficient, I would delete the Mail trains to free up the tracks for the industry traffic.

label: Wyoming Valley PA Coal SAM
author: LWVRR1964 (MrScott2007)
description: In the discovery of hard coals in northeastern Pennsylvania, the railroad companies scrambled to get coal from the Wyoming Valley to the steel mills and comsumers of the north east. Be the last railroad standing in the vally!

label: Australia FV1 SAM2
author: Bobby
description: Help Build The Australian Railways And Make Lots Of Money Make Your Name In the Transport Industry. Help the Country Grow. Transport The People and ship Goods All Over Country. This is a large size 20x20 map.

label: New South Wales V1.1 SAM
author: Bobby
description:
Build The Australian Railways Group And Make Lots Of Money 
	Make Your Name In the Transport Industry. 
	Help the State Grow.		
	Transport The People, Tourists and Politicians.
	Transport Workers to the industries and ship Goods All Over State.
	Ship Tourists to The Ski Resorts and Hotels.
	This is a large size 20 map

label: Alaska SAM
author: d53642
description: Be the last railroad standing

label: Side to Side 3 SAM
author: Snoopy55, Jancsika
description:
At this point, your only job is to transport the goods.  All but Beer need to go from one corner to the other, but that's a long trip thru the middle.  Oh ya, there are no passengers or mail to run.
There are new and tough scenario goals. Your planning skills will be tested. This map was designed by Snoopy and has been one of the first maps that pointed to new way of map design. Now with new scenario goals it is quite a challenge.

label: Mystlander SAM
author: laloha
description:
Develop this small island into a thriving economy. Watch out for the volcano in the northwest!
        
        But first, please read this:
        THANKS to, jowe10, for his original, Mysterious Island, map, that inspired me to pursue, this, my first attempt at map making.
        THANKS, also, must be given to the many members, contributers, at the, SMR forum, http://www.sidmeiersrailroads.net/portal.php, along with all the available components that makeup these maps. They all know who they are, too many to mention. I know I would miss some and I don't want to do that!
        
        This is a map for advanced players.

label: Middle Earth SAM2
author: Lama_RT
description:
In a world where Orcs, Elves, Humans, and other ethnic groups have long made peace, a rush to make money is bringing large-scale development.  Promote prosperity and political unity by creating a railroad network to link all Kingdoms.

NOTES
-   This scenario uses 'slow time', so that each month takes 3.5 times as long as normal.  Engine maintenance costs are adjusted accordingly.
-   Agricultural industries located in cities produce very little output per month.  After hauling off the initial four loads of output that will have accumulated, make sure to adjust train consists accordingly.
-   Industries located in the countryside produce faster than those in cities, but slower than in normal games.  Livestock production can be boosted by feed delveries, and grain production by fertilizer deliveries.
-   First-class passengers are produced and demanded only by Banks.  Boost output by delivering wine and paper.
-   Second-class passenger output can be boosted by supplying Department Stores with textiles and manufactured goods.

label: Rift Valley 3 SAM2
author: Jancsika
description:
After the collapse of the lumber and paper industries the country is facing an extreme emergency. 
You have to build new money making industries. 
There are raw oil, cotton, and grape productions, but you have to find and build manufacturing plants to utilize them, export them and turning them into gold.Meanwhile the people need to be fed. 
You have to develop a food distribution system to utilize your existing stockyard and fromagerie.In order to make the industries produce you have to supply them with adequate labor (passengers).
You have ten years to achieve this miracle. If you fail you might end up in one of those gulags.

label: California Sam
author: Lama_LT
description:
Develop the economy of California, from the Gold Rush to the growth of tourism in the 1880s.

NOTES
- This scenario uses 'slow time', so that each month takes three times as long as normal.  Engine maintenance costs are adjusted accordingly.
- The smelter produces one load of gold per four loads of ore delivered.  All other industries produce just one load of output for every two loads of input.
- Delivering passengers to a gold mine increase gold production (one additional load of ore per each load of passengers).

label: Great Lakes Rail SAM
author: NSRailfan
description: Map of Pittsburgh to Chicago based on the Midwest Map in SMR.

label: Middle East SAM2
author: d53642/snoopy55
description: This is an updated version of the original MID EAST map adding Cotton, Arms and Ports.

label: Africa Challenge SAM
author: Jowe10
description:
Change Log
- Fixed a crash issue which made the map unplayable 

Conquer the wilds of Africa and part of the Middle East in the years 1860-1930.
Cities and industries are more spread out so this map is not for beginners. This is a large map so should be played on computers with more resources.

label: Wisconsin SAM
author: Snoopy55
description: Follow the State of Wisconsin as the first railroad tracks are laid and it's industries grow.  Help it to become the state it now is.

label: Styx SAM
author: Cage.
description: Styx

label: Texarkana SAM
author: jowe10.
description:
Develop the second largest state in the U.S. to economic prosperity.  
	
Along the way you will also have to connect to neighboring states and move passengers through Mexico.
	
This map is for intermediate to advanced players.  There are a number of goals that provide a good challenge in trying to meet them all.

label: River Valley SAM
author: NSrailfan
description: This is a map centered around a valley with a river running through it. There are 9 custom engines in this map. All the cities are named after major US cities, and there are 14 city sizes so it'll take some time to build it up to a size 14 (SuperCity). This is a size 12 map (144 sq. units) and it came out pretty nice.

label: Central Andes SAM
author: IronDukeGeorge
description: This Scenario covers the Central Andes region containing Southern Peru, Bolivia, Northern Chile, Northern Argentina and the Brazilian border. The scenario spans from 1830 to 1980 and covers many major events in South America's often violent history. This area is mostly mountainous so building may become expensive, good luck.

label: 4 Rivers Conversion SAM (Rivers' Run NorthWest)
author: Firaxis Games
description: This multiplayer map is designed for four players. This map features several intertwined rivers sprawling across the map. The economy and trains are based on the NorthWest Scenario. There are only 4 cities, and none of them are next to starting locations. All the rest are Villages, making starting out more of a challenge.

label: Orient Express SAM
author: Lama
description:
Guide the Balkans through a turbulent century with your skills as a railroad tycoon. In 1870, the Ottoman Empire still rules much of the area. Even after independence, the Balkans remain a trouble-spot. The Orient Express provides some glamour, nonetheless. After the Second World War, rebuilding the region is an uphill struggle.

This is a challenging scenario.

label: Heart of Texas Revision 2
author: Slider38
description:
Welcome to Heart of Texas.  This map is played in 3 Eras from spanning from 1920 to 1980.  The map is designed as a one
player and was tested that way.  Play with AI should not present any problems.  You will probably want to build some industries as you
play and there is certainly room for that.  You may want to higher a couple of extra industrial engineers - you will have a number of bridges
to build. I hope that you enjoy Heart of Texas.

label: Chicago to the Rockies SAM
author: BigPapa
description: Expand the West from Chicago to the Rocky Mountains.

label: The Union Pacific Revision 2
author: Slider38
description: This is your chance to make history.  You must complete the eastern segment of the Transcontinental Railroad.  Then you will build a strong Union Pacific railroad network and grow the road by expanding industries in the western United States.

label: New Sosaria SAM
author: CalmDragon
description: New Sosaria, the age between Sosaria and Ultima Britannia.

label: NAFTA Phase II SAM2
author: Jancsika
description:
This map follows the developent and progress of the Americas starting as an agricultural society, to become the world's leading industrial power.  The action will start in 1880 and end in 1960
	There ware three time periods. The agricultural progress 1880-1920. Industrialization 1920-1940. Financial power 1940 - 1960.

label: Florida SAM
author: d53642, zzbusch and Vzbob
description: This scenario covers the Florida Area. It is recommended for all player levels.  Also thanks to Dan Gackly for helping fix the map and making it work better.  Added 2 square islands to simulate oil rigs. Added Objectives by Vzbob

label: Midwest Freight
author: slider38
description: Welcome to Midwest Freight, a SAM designed as a 1 player map.  It plays in 3 Eras starting in 1920.  You will see a Passengers good but it is not used.  It is there because it is a game requirement.  You may find it advantageous to build an industry or 2.  You may also want to re-purpose some industries as you progress.  There are no crossovers.  To cross existing track, you must switch through.  I hope you enjoy Midwest Freight.

label: Arabia SAM
author: TMiller
description:
NOTE:
RRT_Events_Arabia.xml was wrong and was removed, however the map is still unstable

During the 1930's the Ghawar oil field, largest in the world, was discovered in eastern Saudi Arabia. Oil wells were developed by ARAMCO (the Arabian American Oil Company) and oil exporting began. Oil is still being pumped from the Ghawar field and accounts for most of Saudi Arabian exports. Kuwait, Qatar, United Arab Emirates, Iraq and Iran also export oil and are included in this map. Build a railroad to help develop the region. In addition to oil you will need to move dates, livestock, milk, and grain grown in the "Wadis", the Oases of the desert. Wadis are valleys where scarce water may be found after rare rainfalls or pumped from wells. Late in the game you will need to move pilgrims to Mecca and Medina, and build some of the rail projects currently planned by the Saudi Arabian Railway Organization.

label: Himachal_v1.7z
description: All 14 Cities are villages and each has 3 industries already. Cities are not so near as in maps by developer, I mean how can you create junctions on track if cities are so near that sometimes even some length of train is in one city and rest in other. You get good amount of space to build tracks. Also terrain is mountainous and hilly. There are 4 starting locations at corners of map.

label: HVR Crash
author: BTrain
description: This multiplayer map is designed for four players.  This map contains very little in the way of hills or valleys, so tracks will be cheap and trains will be fast.  The trains and economy are based on BTrain's Warped Mind.

label: War Zone SAM
author: jowe10
description:
War rages and the country is relying on the railroads to keep supplies moving to the front line in the Northwest. Most factories reside in the South, away from the enemy invasion on the Northwest beaches. 
	
Troops demand food and new uniforms. The field hospitals need medicine. Bombs are needed at the airfield in Reneaux. To keep morale up, a constant supply of new troops and letters must also be supplied.

This map is for advanced players

label: IBERIA V2 SAM
author: Cabo
description:
Iberia needs someone to wake up. Plunged into a dream of centuries, needs to be developed. You will make that possible.
At first you need to connect four cities and create two food companies. After this initial phase, comes the hard work. Now it develop northern Africa and continue the development process Iberia. Good luck.

label: Demo Map SAM
author: Firaxis/omega552003
description: This scenario is a small sample map that showcases some of the different terrain and industries you'll be able to explore in the full retail version of Sid Meier's Railroads!  This map is limited to 5 trains and 8 different types of goods to deliver.  The full version of the game contains 40 trains, and over 30 goods to ship.

label: Wolf359 SAM
author: Star Ranger4
description: Welcome to Wolf 359, Colonizations newest frontier.  We have settlers all over the continent, but the last of our flyers has died.  We need you to build a rail system to replace the lost transport abilities and restore the planets economy!

label: LongShot SAM2
author: Jancsika
description:
This is  13 x 13 size map.
There are 96 turns/month.
There are 4 Eras.
Era 1 Build up your villages to _Large Village_ to be able to build the industries that needed in Era 2
If you can, build chemical plant in Hordburg and haul Coal to it to produce Nitrates. That will increase your grain production.
Era  2 is the more difficult. The production line runs from
			Oil fields 
			Hordburg (Chemical Plant)
			Annuminas (Medicine to Passengers)
			Taconite Mines
			Pelletizer in Baranduin
			Iron Mill in Harland
			Steel Mill in Osgiliath
			War Factory in Farland
			Military Fort in Edoras
			Metal Works Factory in Lorien
			Bank in Hobbiton
Era 3 	Corn Fields
			Cattle Ranch
			Tannery in Hardbottle
			Football Manufacturer in Osgiliath	
			Manufactured goods in Linhir
			Metropolises (size 9, 10, 11)to receive Goods
Era 4 	Passengers to Linhir, visitors to Hotel and Casino in Farland, gold To Bank in Hobbiton.

label: Northern California
author: slider38
description:
This map is designed as a single player and runs in 3 Eras and from 1860 to 1950.  It features some new goods and traincars and even has redwood trees.  This is a SAM (Stand Alone Map).  Please make sure that there are no other files in your Usermaps or Custom Assets folders.

NORTHERN CALIFORNIA - README

     This map is a single player designed to run in 3 Eras from 1860 to 1950.  All testing was done at the
Mogul level.  It took me several tries to get through it.  

     Initially I could not get it to run on my Windows 10 desktop, so the testing was done on my old laptop 
running Windows 8.  After completion I loaded it back onto my desktop and it ran fine.  Now it did take a 
couple of attempts to get it to start.  I keep getting C++ Runtime errors, but that seems to be par for the 
course with Windows 10 and my desktop.  Hopefully, if you are running Windows 10 it will run fine for you.  
If you find you get some kind of an error, don't give up.  Sometimes it seems like it just takes a few tries 
to get it going, and then it will run OK.

     On game play, there are a lot of options on where to run track.  If you find you are stuck in Era 1, 
try another approach.  It can be done.  I did a little testing at the Robber Baron level just to make sure 
that you could get the map started.  A few adjustments to the RRT_Difficulty.xml were made as a result.
There are a number of locales that need to grow before goals can be met.  Do not wait too long to get
those growing.  It should be noted that the game includes a good called Light.  The lighthouses are setup
as industries so that a game save and subsequent load will not make them disappear which would happen if
they were set up as decorations.  The good light has no value and should be ignored.

     I downsized the map quite a bit from what it initially looked like.  It originally featured 3 sets of 
train cars and a number of additional engines.  It was just too heavy.  All version 3 material (train cars
and diesels) have been removed.  I think it runs well now and in a reasonable time frame.  I hope you enjoy
it and find it gives you a challenge.

label: AZ Canyon V02 SAM
author: Karsten
description:
1871 - The Civil War has taught the nation that, if it wishes to hold the Pacific Coast firmly to the Union, efficient transport will have to be provided  to limit the chance that some foreign country might annex California. Due to concerns of the Indian Reserves, construction is slow up to 1881, but then the Atlantic Pacific Railroad is rushed to completion with princely subsidies of land and money.

1900 -  Prospectors swarm out and discover rich mineral deposits.         

1930 -  To counter the Great Depression, the U.S. Government finances Hoover Dam Project. Las Vegas receives thousands of depression-weary job seekers, who help build the world's largest gravity dam. It supplies hydropower to California, Arizona, Nevada, and Utah. 

1970 -  Tourism comes of age as major economic activity, both in Las Vegas and in beautiful Arizona.

label: Gone With The Wind SAM
author: TMiller
description: GONE WITH THE WIND...This map covers the Southern United States from the introduction of the railroad (1830) to the end of the Civil War (1866).  The southern states were rich in agricultural resources, and developed a strong economy dependent on slave labor to grow cotton and tobacco which were exported to England and the northern states.  The game is intended to be played with 3 AI's (that you will need to buy out) while meeting all the objectives given on the "Victory" screen tab.  Prepare to use only steam locomotives and replace them as more powerful locomotives become available. Run lots of trains to move available goods.  The objectives can all be met, but it is not easy. Good Luck.

label: Western_Kentucky_V2.7z
description:
Western Kentucky was designed as a one player SAM (Stand Alone Map). It plays in 3 Eras which run from 1956 to 2005. It features a good deal of new content. There are no crossovers – you must switch through to cross an existing track. Within the zip file you will find a Goods List which you will find helpful.

If you wish to play against AI, you might want to open the RRT_Bridges_Western_Kentucky.xml and change the overlap bridge
prices to 1500. This will allow you to cross over AI tracks. I hope you enjoy Western Kentucky.

label: My Old Kentucky Home SAM
author: Slider38
description:
A Somewhat Whimsical Look at my Home State of Kentucky.			   
Build the Louisville and Nashville Railroad.

label: Inauguration Special SAM
author: Jancsika.
description:
14 X 14 map, 512 turns/day
There are Seven different group of people, that are going to Washington:
1.Voters from all over the country.
2.Senators from three different Statehouse.
3.Celebrities from Los Angeles
4.Patriots from Denver
5.Stockbrokers from New York.
6.Hippies from San Francisco.
7.CarMakers from Detroit via Vegas.

label: UK Harder Version SAM
author: mojos
description: This scenario covers the majority of Great Britain and covers the time period 1825-1967.  This scenario begins in the early days of steam technology, starting with Stephenson's Planet, and continuing into the modern era with classic machines like the A4 Mallard and Gresley's Flying Scotsman.  This scenario is of medium/hard difficulty.

label: Montana Snow SAM
author: slider38
description:
Montana Snow
	An arctic air mass has brought snow to the Montana region of the United States.  Still, railroads must be built.  Montana Snow was designed as a single player SAM (stand alone map).  Please be sure that there are no other files in your Usermaps or CustomAssets Folders.  There is a Goods List in the Warehouse folder.
	This map features some new goods, industries, etc.  The trees are bare, the pines snow-covered, even the shrubs are brown from the cold and snow. Beware of Tourists.  Only villages will accept them for credit. 
	This map plays in 3 Eras running from 1930 to 2005.  You have much to do.  I hope you enjoy Montana Snow.

label: Haldimand Norfolk SAM
author: RDubs82
description:
The sandy, forested lowlands on the northern shore of Lake Erie were inhabited by the indigenous Huron and Neutral peoples when French explorers arrived in the 17th century, followed after the American Revolution by English settlers and Loyalist refugees. It is now 1849, and the colonial government of Canada West has passed a Railway Guarantee Act to guarantee loan interest on the construction of new railroads not less than 75 miles in length.
American border traffic, raw materials, and international freight are all in dire need of transport. A building boom is on the horizon. The only requirement to qualify for the guarantee is that new roads must be built to something called Provincial Gauge

This scenario is meant to be played with no AI competitors. It's also finicky; if it crashes while loading, try it a second or third time and it should work

label: Devon SAM
author: jowe10, omrail
description:
Set in the lower part of the United Kingdom
	
You are going to need to move people around the region early to prepare for extensive growth later. Later, you will have to move food and milk to support the growing region and then help modernize it by introducing automobile travel.  Finally you will have to create an industrial empire and monoploize the region.

label: Holidays in Ohio - Toy Trains SAM2
author: Lowell
description:
.................MERRY CHRISTMAS....2009................
Greedy robber barons are encroaching on Santa's supply chain, taking over local industries, leeching toys that were to be delivered to Santa's Workshop. 
Create and deliver large quantities of toys and supplies to Santa's Distribution Centers while keeping your competition at bay.
 
Santa and the children of the world are looking to you to save Christmas!
Elves will increase production for industries in-city, cookies, rocking horses, dolls, teddy bears, toy soldiers, egg-nog.

Passengers will increase production for bulk good industries, wood, coal, sheep, grain, milk.
Visitors will shop and spend gold in your cities. Export Toys to earn more Gold. 
Use your Gold to buy Bicycles and Train Sets for all cities.
You will need to startup the basic industries first. 
Once the industries have started housing will be provided for the Elves to move in. 
Passengers and Visitors will arive as city growth progresses. 
Use the Holidays_in_Ohio Funds so you have enough money to get started.

label: North East UK SAM
author: Narra
description: This scenario covers the period from the birth of the railways in 1828 to the era of the Beeching cuts in 1968. During this period, you will face a number of grueling tasks from building the beginings of your empire to making sure that you are the railroad that will survive into the  end of the 20th century and dominate the North East of England.

description: Cattle and Oil are plentiful but not necessarily close to the towns that need them. West Texas is full of oil and minerals, the south has great pastures for cattle.

In late 1865, Colonel Harold Sneedbee petioned President Andrew Johnson and Congress for a grant to build a railroad across the Dakota Territory.

This map was designed as a one player SAM. There are no crossovers. You must switch through to cross existing track. I hope that you enjoy Dakota Territory.

The first engine you have to work with is small and has a difficult time moving long stretches of cars. Also, be careful where you lay your rails and be sure to look ahead at future Victory Conditions.
Avoid bridges and tunnels as much as you can since they are very expensive to build.

author: enould

label: Wisconsin 2 SAM
author: snoopy55 / Big Papa / Jancsika
description:
Follow the State of Wisconsin as the first railroad tracks are laid and it's industries grow.  Help it to become the state it now is.
	The 19th Century Era.
Cities and towns grow; the rails connect the outlying settlements, bringing food beer and other necessities to the growing population.

Welcome to Keystone State.  This map was designed as a one-player SAM.  It features some new goods, industries, etc.

label: Lberia_v1_06.7z
description:
Iberia bridge between continents.

We are in 1850, and a connection between France and Algeria is required for transporting oil. Yet we first must build a railroad that loops through the Iberian peninsula.

In the first phase you have to connect four cities, namely, Madrid, Lisbon, Barcelona and Bordeaux. Then create two food companies and transport the resulting food.

In the second phase we must transport: vehicles from Barcelona, oil from Brest, Brest manufactured goods from Cadiz, and paper from Alicante to Santigo newspaper. You must connect all cities in Africa and cities in northen Iberia: Gijon, Santander and Biarritz. Transport passengers Gijon-Biarritz, and Ouazzane-Barcelona and Argel-Lyon. Transport food from Ouazzane to Oran, Tiaret and Argel. Make Argel a Metropolis. Money: Net worth 75.000.000 pta and 100% share of your company.

INTRODUCTION
------------

Iberia bridge between continents.

We are in 1850, and required a connection between France and Algeria for transporting oil, but for this we must build a railroad that loops through the Iberian peninsula.

In the first phase you have to connect four cities, namely, Madrid, Lisbon, Barcelona and Bordeaux, create two food companies and transporting that food.

In the second phase must carry: vehicles from Barcelona, oil from Brest, Brest manufactured goods from Cadiz and paper from Alicante to Santigo newspaper. You must connect all cities in Africa and cities in northen Iberia: Gijon, Santander and Biarritz. Transport passengers Gijon-Biarritz, and Ouazzane-Barcelona and Argel-Lyon. Transport food from Ouazzane to Oran, Tiaret and Argel. Make Argel a Metropolis. Money: Net worth 75.000.000 pta and 100% share of your company.


OBJECTIVE OF THE STAGE.
-----------------------

This scenario consists of two phases. 1st Phase: 1850-1880 and 2nd phase: 1881-1970

* First phase 1850-1880.

- Construct two food producing industries, a grain processing and other meat processing.
- Ship 67 loads of food.
- Connect these four cities: Lisboa, Madrid, Barcelona, Burdeos.

* Second phase 1881-1965.

- Connect Brest and Argel.
- Connect North Africa, unite these cities: Larache, Ifran, Ouazzane, Oran, Tiaret and Melilla.
- Carry 100 cars oil to Brest.
- Transport 100 manufactured goods from Brest refinery to Cadiz.
- Transport 200 cars from the factory in Barcelona.
- Paper transport 65 cars from the Alicante to Santiago newspaper.
- Connect Gijon, Santander and Biarritz.
- Make a furniture plant in Gijon
- Transport manufactured goods from Gijon: 80 to Lisboa and 50 to Marsella.
- Transport 55 wagons of passengers: Gijon to Biarritz and Biarritz to Gijon.
- Transport 20 loads of food to Ouazzane to Oran, Argel and Tiaret.
- Transport 70 loads of passengers from Ouazzane to Barcelona and 55 from Argel to Lyon.
- Make Argel a Metropolis.
- Net worth: 75.000.000 pta.
- 100% of share of your company.
- Eliminate all competitors.

label: Western New York and Pennsylvania Railroad
author: NSrailfan
description:
This is a map of the Western New York And Pennsylvania Railroad ( WNYP ). 
The Western New York and Pennsylvania railroad began operations in 
2001, and is still operating today and is a small shortline / Class III 
railroad with 330 miles of track. It's headquarters is in Falconer, New York.
 It is not an independent railway though, it is controlled by the  Livonia, 
Avon and Lakeville Railroad. 

The main challenge of this map is to run it like you would in real life. 
Try to have only one of engine on the map at a time and try to make it 
mainly single line, with some double track.

I would like to thank Snoopy55 for painting the engines for the map 
and Step Inc. for all the industries and traincars and the forklift annex.
